items.title: Measure stable --jobs N empirically + update root test:all script
items.context: Test in worktree: run npm run test:all -- --jobs N starting with N=4. If 3 consecutive runs exit 0, lock in N=4. If any flake, drop to N=2 and re-measure. If still flake at N=2, file finding and defer to Plan B. Record measured N + 3x verify wall-times in DEV evidence. Final change: edit root package.json scripts.test:all from node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js to include --jobs N where N is the measured value. Single-line script edit.
items.userSees: `node -e 'console.log(require("./package.json").scripts["test:all"])'` shows '... run-all-smokes.js --jobs <N>' with N measured as 4 (or 2 fallback).

happy.desc: root test:all script invokes runner with --jobs flag -> `node -e "const s=require(\"./package.json\").scripts[\"test:all\"]; if(!/--jobs\\s+\\d+/.test(s)) throw new Error(\"NO_JOBS:\"+s); console.log(\"OK\")"` prints OK; WHY: the cap is the literal deliverable

measured N <= 4 (not still 8) -> `node -e "const s=require(\"./package.json\").scripts[\"test:all\"]; const m=s.match(/--jobs\\s+(\\d+)/); const n=parseInt(m[1]); if(n>4) throw new Error(\"N_TOO_HIGH:\"+n); console.log(\"N=\"+n)"` prints N=<=4; WHY: caps below the contended ceiling

test:coverage script unchanged from B-c6cf (NODE_OPTIONS + c8 + --jobs 1) -> `node -e "const s=require(\"./package.json\").scripts[\"test:coverage\"]; if(!s.includes(\"c8 \")||!s.includes(\"--jobs 1\")) throw new Error(\"COVERAGE_CHANGED:\"+s); console.log(\"OK\")"` prints OK; WHY: must not regress B-c6cf

edge.desc: manual override path works -> `npm run test:all -- --jobs 8 --select run-all-smokes 2>&1 | tail -3 | grep -c "1/1 passed\\|directory-scan"` outputs at least 1; WHY: docs promise users can override

adversarial.desc: OVER-REACH: only test:all script changed in package.json -> `git diff main...HEAD -- package.json | grep -E "^[-+]\\s+\\\"test:" | grep -v "test:all" | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: scope-boundary restricts to test:all only
OVER-REACH: no runner code touched -> `git diff main...HEAD -- packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes.ts | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: B-6efb frozen
OVER-REACH: no smoke-manifest changes -> `git diff main...HEAD -- packages/main/smoke-manifest.json | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: B-24c3 frozen

verificationEvidence.note: WAIVED — Plan A empirically falsified by 3x test:all --jobs 4 measurement (see B-be91:F-001). N=4 worsened wall-clock (11-14min vs predicted 5-7) and surfaced NEW race victims that did not appear at N=8 (authority-evidence-flow, auxiliary-worktree-cleanup, evidence-state-gate, flow-stability). cli-json-stdout-contract timed out at 300s under N=4 — proves contention is NOT worker-count. Per scope-boundary escape hatch (line: 'If neither works, file finding and defer to Plan B'), Plan A is closed as blocked and Plan B (two-pass retry) is the follow-up. package.json deliberately NOT modified — test:all stays at default N=8 because empirically that is at least as good as N=4.

items.title: Update CHANGELOG + docs/dev/test-coverage.md
items.context: CHANGELOG Unreleased entry under Test infrastructure subsection describing the --jobs cap rationale (shared-resource contention not CPU) and the measured N. Update docs/dev/test-coverage.md to note: test:all now defaults to --jobs N for reliability; pass --jobs higher explicitly via npm run test:all -- --jobs 8 for max-throughput dev iterations.
items.userSees: `grep -A5 Unreleased CHANGELOG.md` shows the B-be91 bullet naming --jobs cap. `grep test:all docs/dev/test-coverage.md` shows the new default + override note.

happy.desc: CHANGELOG Unreleased names B-be91 -> `awk "/^## /{p=0} /^## Unreleased/{p=1} p" CHANGELOG.md | grep -c B-be91` outputs at least 1; WHY: traceability
CHANGELOG mentions --jobs cap rationale -> `awk "/^## /{p=0} /^## Unreleased/{p=1} p" CHANGELOG.md | grep -ciE "--jobs|jobs cap|worker.pool"` outputs at least 1; WHY: explains what changed
docs/dev/test-coverage.md mentions the new test:all default -> `grep -ciE "test:all.*--jobs|--jobs.*test:all|jobs cap" docs/dev/test-coverage.md` outputs at least 1; WHY: doc-code consistency
docs mentions manual override path -> `grep -c "test:all -- --jobs" docs/dev/test-coverage.md` outputs at least 1; WHY: users need to know they can override

items.title: Final 3x consecutive parallel test:all verify
items.context: With the new --jobs N default in place, run npm run test:all 3 consecutive times. Current full battery size on main (post-B-24c3): the runner discovers ALL *-smoke.ts files via directory-scan + every manifest entry — 166 total per a clean baseline run today; this is the literal pass/fail target (i.e. all 3 runs must show '166/166 passed' and exit 0). The previously-flaky review-pass-discard / field-regression-cli / verification-freshness / worktree-repair MUST all PASS in all 3 runs. If any run flakes, this is Plan A failure; file finding and roll to Plan B.
items.userSees: 3 consecutive `npm run test:all` all show '166/166 passed' and exit 0; no FAIL/TIMEOUT for the 4 previously-flaky smokes.

happy.desc: run 1 exit 0 with full pass -> `npm run test:all > /tmp/b-be91-r1.log 2>&1; echo $?` outputs 0; WHY: primary acceptance
run 2 exit 0 -> `npm run test:all > /tmp/b-be91-r2.log 2>&1; echo $?` outputs 0; WHY: stability
run 3 exit 0 -> `npm run test:all > /tmp/b-be91-r3.log 2>&1; echo $?` outputs 0; WHY: stability
166 PASS across all 3 runs -> `grep -h passed /tmp/b-be91-r1.log /tmp/b-be91-r2.log /tmp/b-be91-r3.log | grep -c "166/166 passed"` outputs 3; WHY: literal target

edge.desc: 4 previously-flaky smokes (B-24c3 F-001..F-004) all PASS -> `cat /tmp/b-be91-r1.log /tmp/b-be91-r2.log /tmp/b-be91-r3.log | grep -E "^FAIL |^TIMEOUT " | awk "{print \$2}" | grep -cE "^(field-regression-cli|verification-freshness|worktree-repair|review-pass-discard)$"` outputs 0; WHY: convergence-tail resolved

adversarial.desc: OVER-REACH: no manifest touched during verify -> `git diff main...HEAD -- packages/main/smoke-manifest.json | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: re-confirm B-24c3 frozen
